visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up focuses on a dark-colored doughnut coated in white sugar and topped with pink cream and a single raspberry. It sits on a white napkin displaying a large black question mark. To the left, a glass of amber-colored liquid with ice is visible on a light wood surface. Overlaid text in pink and white boxes fills the upper half of the frame. (2) A wooden cart display filled with dozens of varied pastries transitions to a static shot of a grey concrete building exterior. The gold metallic "dacō" logo is mounted on the wall. Brown fallen leaves are scattered on the grey pavement below. White text boxes appear at the bottom and center. (3) In a brightly lit kitchen with stainless steel surfaces, a worker in a white uniform and hat meticulously places doughnuts onto a tray. The scene cuts to a long, minimalist counter inside a modern shop where hundreds of pastries are displayed in neat rows. Multiple staff members in matching uniforms are visible in the background. (4) A pair of hands enters the frame to pick up a pink-filled doughnut and pull it apart, exposing the light pink creamy interior. The hands then hold a small pastry topped with a whole strawberry and white cream. The background is a neutral, out-of-focus wall. Various text captions appear in white and red. (5) A round, dark bun with a slice taken out to show cream and caramel is held up. The camera then shows a wide view of the shop's interior, featuring customers in dark clothing browsing the counter. The lighting is warm and even. A sign on a glass door details cashless payment information in black and white. (6) The shop's front entrance is shown with several people standing outside under a large glowing question mark sign. The video finishes with a pink graphic screen containing social media icons, the "japanuts.com" URL, and text inviting viewers to like, comment, and share. Icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube are clearly visible.
